title: LK-99 room-temperature superconductor papers

tellings.quote: Do you know that that team was so sure of their results that they published one paper with six authors and then they published another paper with three authors because only three people can share a Nobel Prize. They were that confident.

plain: In 2023 a team in South Korea published papers on LK-99, a material they said was a superconductor at room temperature, meaning it carries electricity with no resistance and needs no extreme cooling. A guest named Jack says the team was so sure of its result that it put out one paper with six authors and a second with only three, because a Nobel Prize can be shared by at most three people. He tells it, from memory and without a source, as an example of how confident the researchers were.
